app BddIndependent
Given
 contract Answer { text:text, ok:bool }
When
 scenario echo(value:text) read=true -> text by=members
  do return value
  examples
   value -> lower(value=result)
   lower(value="HI") -> lower(value="HI")
  examples
   do
    let original=lower(value="HI")
    call echo {value=original} by=self as saved
    lower(value=saved),lower(value=result) -> "hi","hi"
    call flag {value=true} by=self
    saved,result -> "hi",true
    let later=lower(value=saved)
    later -> "hi"
 scenario flag(value:bool) read=true -> bool by=members
  do return value
Then
